raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven sustainability professional with 15+ years of experience, including 8+ years in ESG consulting and reporting frameworks. Proven expertise in BRSR, GRI, SASB, CDP, CSRD, and TCFD standards with demonstrated success in GHG accounting, materiality assessments, and stakeholder engagement. Accomplished in ESG ratings and assessments including DJSI-CSA, with a track record of improving client ESG scores to leadership levels. Strategic leader committed to driving sustainable business transformation through comprehensive ESG implementation and reporting excellence.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
ESG Reporting & Frameworks - BRSR, GRI Standards, SASB, CDP, CSRD, TCFD, ESRS • Corporate Sustainability Assessment (DJSI-CSA) • Double Materiality Assessments
Sustainability Strategy & Consulting - Gap Assessment & Materiality Analysis • Stakeholder Engagement & Workshop Facilitation • ESG Policy Development & Implementation
Carbon & Environmental Accounting - GHG Protocol (Scope 1, 2 & 3 Emissions) • Carbon Footprint Quantification & Reporting • Environmental Impact Assessment
ESG Ratings & Analysis - S&P Global ESG Ratings • Sustainalytics ESG Risk Ratings • MSCI ESG Ratings
Lead and managed cross-functional teams (8-12 professionals) in complex ESG materiality assessments for multinational corporations.
Technical & Project Management - Project Management & Client Engagement • Power BI • MS Office Suite • Generative AI (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) • AI-assisted Research & Reporting
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) - Assistant Manager (February 2022 – Present)
Delivered comprehensive ESG reporting solutions by drafting SEBI mandated Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reports (BRSR) and Sustainability reports in reference to GRI- Standards for 15+ clients across Manufacturing, Battery, Pharma, Steel, Banking, and E commerce sectors, achieving 100% on-time delivery.
Conducted advanced materiality assessments including double materiality analysis and IRO mapping for multinational corporations, identifying critical sustainability matters for CSRD reporting compliance.
Authored strategic CDP responses providing gap assessments and actionable recommendations that elevated client scores to CDP Leadership A-level.
Calculated and reported greenhouse gas emissions (Scope 1, 2 & 3) for diverse organizations using GHG Protocol
Managed end-to-end project lifecycles for 15+ ESG engagements, maintaining 97% client satisfaction rate from initial proposals through final delivery
Led client workshops and training sessions for 200+ stakeholders across various organizations/key departments, improving ESG data collection accuracy and reducing reporting cycle time by 25%
Developed ESG and compliance policies by conducting thorough gap assessments for 8+ clients, resulting in 90% policy implementation success rate and enhanced regulatory compliance
S&P Global Inc - Senior Data Researcher I - ESG Data (November 2018 - January 2022)
Analyzed and disseminated ESG data for DJSI Index family by drafting 500+ comprehensive Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA) responses
Served as Subject Matter Expert (SME) providing resolutions for ESG-related queries
Performed quality assurance reviews of ESG data points, achieving high data accuracy and reducing error rates.
Conducted ethical exclusionary screening for 200+ companies annually, analyzing corporate involvement in restricted sectors and determining revenue impact.
Directed data quality review projects, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and methodological integrity across large ESG datasets.
Analyzed climate disclosures (CDP, TCFD, SDGs) and materiality matrices, benchmarking companies against global ESG standards.
S&P Global Inc - Data Researcher III - Corporate Governance Takeover Defence (August 2010 - October 2018)
Managed research workflows to capture corporate governance and takeover defense strategies for Fortune 500 and global firms.
Extracted and validated governance data from proxies, annual reports, SEC/Sedar filings, and public disclosures.
Delivered benchmarking reports on governance frameworks and shareholder rights to support institutional investors.
Collaborated with cross-regional teams, ensuring timely delivery and accuracy of governance datasets.

raw_sections.awards:
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Transformed ESG performance for clients from average to Leadership level through strategic CDP response optimization, resulting in 40% average score improvement and enhanced investor confidence.
Successfully delivered 10+ major ESG reports across diverse industry sectors within tight deadlines, maintaining 100% on-time delivery rate over 4+ years.
Enhanced data quality processes resulting in 35% improvement in accuracy metrics and 98% client satisfaction scores across engagements.
